rect.title: Email/password login (optional Google login: not started)
Mobile-first and installable as an app. Mobile layout is done (44px tap targets, no sideways scrolling). Missing: proper app icons, and a verified install.
Light and dark mode (System, Light or Dark in Settings)
Each user's data is private, plus data export and delete-account. Privacy is done and tested. Missing: export and delete-account.
Hebrew and English, including right-to-left

OBD-II / manufacturer API odometer
Step 1: Accounts, cars, odometer. Done (MVP1-A, B and C signed off), apart from the gaps marked below. Settings signed off: language, theme and currency (SET-1), and km or miles (SET-2).
Step 2: Maintenance tasks, templates, Reset. Done (MVP2-A, B and C signed off).

Step 3: Service history with costs MVP3-A, B, C and D signed off (history list, record a past service with parts and labour, edit everything including date, odometer and tasks, delete, filter and search on the Service history page). 🔨 Now: LOW-1 (a batch of small fixes). Missing: attachments (waits for Cloudflare R2).
Step 4: Dashboard with due and overdue status 🔨 Next: MVP4-A (overdue and due-soon counts, this month's spend, each car's next tasks with Mark done and quick odometer entry)
Step 5: Checklists, then tires, then reports and notifications
Before going online: SEC-1 (limit login attempts, account lockout, constant-time login). Signed off.
Checklist templates
Items: checkbox, number or text
Schedule by km, by time, or manual only
Run a checklist: tick items, add notes or photos, flag issues
Failed items create a to-do or a maintenance task
Run history per car
Task name and category
Interval by km, by time, or both (whichever comes first)
Starter template library, fully editable (12 templates; the owner should review their intervals)
Custom tasks per car
Turn a task off without deleting it
Date, odometer, shop or DIY, total cost, notes (one record can cover several tasks)
Line items: part, brand, part number, quantity, unit cost, labour (total is the sum of the items)
Attachments: receipt photos, PDFs, invoices
Filter and search by car, task, date or shop (Service history page, all cars, filters kept in the link)
Edit and delete past records (everything on a record, including date, odometer and tasks; the car's odometer and the tasks' last done follow)
Tire sets: brand, model, size, season, purchase year, DOT code
Which set is on which car, with mount and unmount dates
Km driven per set, calculated automatically
Pressure log, tread depth log, rotation tracking
Storage notes for the off-season set
Add, edit and archive cars, keeping their history
Fields: nickname, make, model, year, VIN, plate, fuel type, purchase date, photo. Missing: photo upload, which needs Cloudflare R2 set up.
Current odometer, with a history of readings, which you can edit and delete
Multiple cars per account
Manual odometer updates with a quick-entry button. Works on the car list and car page; the dashboard doesn't exist yet.
Auto-log the odometer when a service is recorded (Mark done and the Record a service form)
Average km/day, used to predict due dates. Calculated and shown. Not used for predictions yet; that comes with the dashboard or later.
Km/miles unit, and a currency per user (both in Settings; every distance on screen is converted)
Remaining km and days, a progress bar, and status: OK, Due soon, Overdue
Reset / Mark as done (records odometer and date, restarts the countdown, creates a history entry with optional cost and notes)
Undo for accidental resets (right after the reset, and any record from the service history)
Configurable "due soon" threshold (percent, 1 to 50)
Cost per car, per category, per month and per year
Cost per km and total cost of ownership
Charts: spending over time, cost by category
Export to CSV and PDF
Email (and optional push) when a task is due soon or overdue
Non-mileage reminders: insurance, inspection, registration, licence
Snooze, and a configurable lead time
All cars at a glance, next due items sorted by urgency 🔨
Overdue count and monthly spend summary 🔨
Quick actions: update odometer, reset a task, start a checklist 🔨 (MVP4-A covers odometer and reset; "start a checklist" waits for checklists)
Create a Cloudflare R2 bucket and access key. This blocks car photos and receipts.

Review the delegated decisions in docs/decisions.md, especially the 12 starter task intervals, the task status rules (when a task counts as "Due soon" or "Overdue"), the Reset and Undo rules (a one-tap reset counts as DIY; Undo only for the latest reset of a task), the settings rules (changing the currency does not convert old amounts; only ILS, USD, EUR and GBP), the km/miles rules (converted template intervals such as 6,214 mi rather than round mile values; the unit is not asked at sign-up; the Hebrew label "קילומטראז׳" kept in miles), the service history rules (undone records are hidden; an old service never moves a task's last done backwards; Undo works on any record, in any order; a corrected later-dated service at a lower odometer moves last done to that lower reading), the line item rules (the total becomes the sum of the items whenever there are items), the search rules (a separate Service history page for all cars, read-only, with edit and delete staying on the car page; the search doesn't look in task names), and the edit rules for MVP3-D (changing a service's date, odometer or tasks moves the car's odometer and the tasks' last done; a service can't be moved to another car), two readings on the same day now ordered by value (the higher one counts as later), and the dashboard rules (home page /; this month's spend includes archived cars so it matches the Service history page; one-tap Mark done without cost or notes).
Create an Azure account, when it's time to deploy. You said not yet, so no deployment work is planned until you say so.
